name: Mycelium
author: E. T. Carter
description: A hyphal network spreading through dark substrate, seen from above under a black light. Pale branching threads fork at acute angles with dark ground between them, each strand growing from its root behind a bright swollen tip, standing a while, then dying back as a new one sprouts. Pulses of bioluminescence stream along the threads over a soft combed haze of finer hyphae.

params.label: Runner density
params.effect: How many leading hyphae fan out from the origin; low is a few sparse cords, high is a dense fine fan.

params.label: Growth speed
params.effect: How fast each wave of growth sweeps across the frame and how fast the pulses stream; 0 freezes the colony.

params.label: Twigs
params.effect: Density of the short lateral twigs sprouting off the runners; 0 leaves only the long hyphae.

params.label: Bioluminescence
params.effect: Strength of the halo, tip glow and travelling pulses; 0 is matte pale threads on soil.

params.label: Wander
params.effect: How far the hyphae curve off straight; 0 is a stiff radial fan, high is meandering threads.
